title: Simple Exercises, Serious progress- 12 weaks
desc:
This 12-week program is designed to build a stronger, leaner, more muscular and athletic physique through simple effective exercises, progressive overload, cardio and consistent nutrition.

The main goal is to gain muscle and strength while improving conditioning and gradually reducing body-fat percentage. Extra focus is placed on shoulders, back, arms, abs, forearms and overall proportions.

SMOLOV JR BENCH: Alongside the program, I am running a separate Smolov Jr Bench Press Challenge. On scheduled Smolov Jr days, bench is performed before the normal gym workout while energy and focus are highest. Smolov Jr is tracked separately and does not need to be included in the normal workouts. Since it already creates a lot of chest, triceps and pressing volume, other exercises can be adjusted if recovery or performance suffers. The goal is to significantly improve bench strength and work towards a much stronger 1RM.

CARDIO: Aim for at least 2 cardio/conditioning sessions every week. This can include running, intervals, cycling, swimming, incline walking or calisthenics. Cardio is used to improve endurance, fitness and athleticism while helping support a lean physique and lower body-fat percentage. Cardio should be planned intelligently so it does not interfere with gym performance or recovery.

NUTRITION: Track food intake consistently and prioritize plenty of protein for muscle growth and recovery. Carbohydrates are especially important on hard training days to fuel Smolov Jr, gym training and cardio. Training days may require slightly more calories and carbohydrates than rest days, but calories should still be controlled to avoid unnecessary fat gain. The goal is not to crash diet for abs, but to eat enough to perform, recover and build muscle while gradually becoming leaner.

RECOVERY & PROGRESS: Prioritize high-quality sleep and include stretching/mobility regularly. Track body weight and focus on weekly averages rather than individual weigh-ins. Also track progress photos, gym performance, bench strength and cardio performance. Increase weights or reps gradually with good technique instead of simply training to failure every session.

After 12 weeks the goal is to be stronger, more muscular, leaner, fitter and more athletic, with better conditioning, a noticeably stronger bench press and a physique to be proud of.

Simple exercises. Serious consistency. Serious progress.
